capabilities: Renumber headings automatically when they are inserted, removed, or moved
Update Wiki and Markdown heading links when a uniquely referenced heading is renamed
Render heading numbers virtually without writing to Markdown
Audit existing broken or ambiguous heading links with an explicit review and repair plan
Reconcile unopened notes when they are opened
extras: At README time the community listing was still under review, with GitHub release download as the install path; real-device mobile validation was still in progress for version 0.2.6, and persisted mode warns against running other heading-numbering plugins concurrently.
problem: Obsidian silently leaves heading hierarchies unrenumbered and heading links broken or ambiguous when headings are inserted, removed, moved, or renamed.
summary: Heading maintenance plugin that automatically numbers headings and keeps heading-fragment links synchronized, with virtual rendering by default and opt-in persisted writes.
